parsed.review_summary: The candidate edit correctly addresses both error targets. It removes the incorrect claim that the comment refers to a specific part of the paper (the introduction of the ProbTransformer model) and replaces it with an accurate observation that the comment only names the model without pinpointing a section, figure, table, or location. It also revises the conclusion to accurately reflect that the comment specifies what issues need to be addressed but the authors cannot confidently determine which part of the paper is being referenced, without stating a numeric score or gold label. Unrelated correct reasoning about the two specific issues (biological circumstances and RNA abundance) is preserved. The rationale is coherent and suitable for insertion into a rescoring pipeline.
